scope: Experimental stage2 compiler/native-stdlib packages, not shipped full distributions
cache_policy: No compiler cache; cache hit rate N/A; fresh objects per arm
cargo_policy: Common pinned stage0 Cargo; both builders must provide the identical executable
stdlib_policy: Each arm keeps its own built native stdlib; byte identity required, no transplantation
qualification: Compiler smoke plus IronRDP native unit/integration correctness; workspace restricted to --lib --bins --tests, no doctests; NOT full upstream extracted-distribution tests
blocked_full_release: Pinned tool.rs retains Cargo-profile LTO handling affected by cargo#14575; rust#128947 proposes tool handling and stack changes. This pilot changes neither.
interpretation: Incremental compiler effect with repaired fixed PGO, not actual combined-PR shipped artifacts, release-production cost, application runtime, or a cache benchmark
